tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels. The body background on every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables, dialogs and the top bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Track behind segmented controls and section tabs; neutral tags.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons, nav tabs and list items.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Table header row, dialog footer, sub-headers inside panels.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel and card borders, table header rule, top bar rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists; panel header rule.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Kept from the wireframes; it is under 3:1 on surface in light, so controls also rely on their fill and label.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and table text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, column headers, subtitles. 5.3:1 on surface in light.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Unselected section tabs, ghost buttons, dialog captions.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button labels only. Never for readable text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected chips, meters, the logo, the current phase. White text on it passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links on text, Jira keys, selected nav tab label, question ids.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav tab, soft buttons, passed phases, the avatar, recommendation boxes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px outline, 1px offset) on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-queued-bg
tokens.usage: Queued badge (ready).

tokens.name: status-queued-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-queued-bg.

tokens.name: status-running-bg
tokens.usage: Under way badge (running) and the live run pulse.

tokens.name: status-running-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-running-bg.

tokens.name: status-input-bg
tokens.usage: Crew asks badge (awaiting_input); open question highlight.

tokens.name: status-input-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-input-bg.

tokens.name: status-decision-bg
tokens.usage: Your orders badge (awaiting_decision); waiting gate rows.

tokens.name: status-decision-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-decision-bg.

tokens.name: status-halted-bg
tokens.usage: Anchored badge (halted); the stopped phase in the stepper.

tokens.name: status-halted-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-halted-bg.

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Docked badge (terminal, done); pass outcomes; succeeded runs.

tokens.name: status-done-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-done-bg.

tokens.name: status-blocked-bg
tokens.usage: Aground badge (terminal, blocked). Inverted so it reads as final in both themes.

tokens.name: status-blocked-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-blocked-bg.

tokens.name: status-sendback-bg
tokens.usage: send_back gate outcome and the send-back dialog icon.

tokens.name: status-sendback-fg
tokens.usage: Text on status-sendback-bg.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The Live dot in the top bar and log headers. Always paired with the word Live.

tokens.name: live-halo
tokens.usage: Halo ring around the live dot.

tokens.name: live-text
tokens.usage: The word Live next to the dot.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive confirm buttons (Stop voyage, Reject plan). White text on it.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Destructive outline buttons, required asterisks, inline field errors.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of destructive outline buttons and invalid fields.

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Changed-since-you-opened-it banner; planned-screen note.

tokens.name: notice-line
tokens.usage: Border of notice banners.

tokens.name: notice-fg
tokens.usage: Text on notice-bg.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Anchored explanation box, decided-first and reject warnings.

tokens.name: error-line
tokens.usage: Border of error boxes.

tokens.name: error-fg
tokens.usage: Text on error-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Cost confirmation boxes and agent recommendations.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info boxes.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marks text that changed since the last plan revision.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added lines in artifact compare.

tokens.name: diff-add-fg
tokens.usage: Text on diff-add-bg.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed lines in artifact compare.

tokens.name: diff-del-fg
tokens.usage: Text on diff-del-bg.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast background, inverted against the page.

tokens.name: toast-fg
tokens.usage: Text on toast-bg.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: the page or screen title.

styles.name: voyage-title
styles.sample: Show invoice due date on the billing page
styles.usage: The story title in the voyage header.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a panel; card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Voyages waiting on a person. Only the owner is billed.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Buttons, nav tabs, field labels, emphasised values.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Show each invoice's due date on the billing page and in the invoice list.
styles.usage: Rendered agent output: plans, snapshots. Keep lines near 75 characters.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges, outcome pills and counts.

styles.name: caps-label
styles.usage: Table column headers and meta labels. Always uppercase (text-transform), muted ink.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Usage tiles on run detail. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: tile-number
styles.usage: Counts on the All hands tiles.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Jira keys, run ids (r-04), question ids (Q2). Coloured accent-text when linked.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API terms (awaiting_decision), model ids, phases, file paths, AIU figures in tables.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Agent-config commit hashes and request ids; always muted, never the focus.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and between nav tabs.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; between label and input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Panel header gap; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles; question card padding; field rows.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Table cell side padding; gap between panels on a voyage page.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel body padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop; top bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Jira status tags, step icons, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons (28px), inputs inside tables, section tab items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, banners inside panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tiles, question cards, page-level banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, nav tabs, search field, meters, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: The selected item in a segmented control or section tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the page. Panels never get a shadow; they use line borders.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in table rows and panel headers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and search height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The one confirm button in a form summary (Set sail · up to 25 AIU).

tokens.name: badge-height
tokens.usage: Status badges and outcome pills.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Signed-in user avatar in the top bar.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content; tables wrap inside it and never scroll sideways.
